features.t: Redshift clusters + SQL through the Redshift Data API
x: Clusters (Query API 2012-12-01: CreateCluster/DescribeClusters/ModifyCluster/DeleteCluster/RebootCluster) are real with AWS validation, including ManageMasterPassword (a Secrets Manager secret owned by redshift, rotated and deleted with the cluster). The Redshift Data API runs ANY SQL (CREATE/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/SELECT, joins, aggregates) on the cluster's own SQLite engine; writes are kept as a statement log and replayed after a reboot/reload. The SQL dialect is SQLite's, not Redshift's: no distkey/sortkey semantics, COPY/UNLOAD, Spectrum, stored procedures or columnar storage; node types and counts are metadata; no snapshots, resize or WLM. No Redshift console page yet - use the CLI/SDK (aws redshift, aws redshift-data) or pick the cluster when storing a Secrets Manager Redshift credential.
